profile.scope: N02 surf stance with normal upright-head cloud flight

calibration.soleSource: posed foot-weighted skin vertices projected on support normal

replay.sampling: controls sampled at the end of each integration step

environment.renderMode: CPU scene onBeforeRender/onAfterRender transaction; no pixels rendered

calibration.method: Initial posed skin soles, foot anchors and weighted-bone COM proxy; same formulas as local demo

limitations: Self-authored fixture numerical replay only; no new real-VRM or visual acceptance.
COM/ZMP and sole normals are model proxies, not measured contact forces or full-body rigid-body physics.
Rotational point acceleration, collision, tracking, XRift, Quest and multi-user synchronization are unverified.
